explanation: BGSAVE forks a child process that writes a point-in-time snapshot of the dataset to the RDB file while the parent keeps serving clients; copy-on-write keeps the child's view stable without duplicating the whole dataset.

options.text: Forks a child process that writes a point-in-time snapshot to the RDB file
Backs up the AOF file to disk without pausing writes
Copies the dataset to a replica over the replication link
Flushes the operating system page cache for dump.rdb
